page.title: Any question?
page.subtitle: Write to us. We reply within 24 to 48 working hours. For match emergencies, prefer the phone.

form.privacy_note: We protect your data. No spam, promise.

consent.body_prefix: By sending this message you entrust Dina Kenitra FC with your contact details (identity, contact) solely to reply to you. In line with Law 09-08, no automatic archiving is done in our database: your message is forwarded by email to the staff. Full policy:
consent.checkbox_body: that Dina Kenitra FC uses this information to process my request.
